records.subject: Welcome to Wrenfield, Ridge Analytics!
records.body:
Hi Jules,

Welcome to Wrenfield! Your workspace is ready. A good first step is to create your first project and invite a teammate.

If anything's unclear, just reply here.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.text: New signup alert -- *Ridge Analytics* just created a workspace on pro.

decisions.rationale: Six days post-signup with zero product progress (no project, no invite, no milestone) and no reply to the welcome email [email:cff3a621]. No tickets, so no engagement signal at all. Silent accounts that haven't started by day 6 rarely self-activate in the remaining 8 days, though the active Pro plan gives some upside.

draft.subject: A quick hand getting your first project up
draft.body:
Hi Jules,

Checking in since your Wrenfield workspace went live last week. If it helps, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, and the in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project. When you're ready to bring the rest of Ridge Analytics in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week work? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that comes up.

Best,
Priya
